name: Lakeshore Eats Inc. (Test)
idRule: id = <client>-<TAG>-<YYYY>-<MM>-<seq>. TAG names the account (CHQ chequing, USD US-dollar chequing, BCD business card, PCD personal card, BRK brokerage). YYYY-MM is the month of the row date. seq is the 1-based position of the row among that account and month, in file order (header lines do not count). Rows missing from an export get the next numbers of their month.
amountConvention: amount is the cash effect on the company account: money in is positive, money out is negative. On a card a charge is negative and a payment positive (the card CSV shows the opposite sign). post lines list the coded entry: dr and cr in dollars, the last line is the bank or card account itself.
postingCurrency: CAD: every post line, adjusting entry and trial balance figure is in Canadian dollars; USD rows are posted at the monthly test rate in fx

flags.rule: HST quick method: rate, line 101 and no input tax credits on costs
flags.detail: Quick method rate used: 8.8% (confirm against CRA; whether a restaurant counts as a service supplier or a retailer decides the rate). Remittance = rate x tax-included sales of the quarter, no credits on expenses, credit on the kitchen equipment only. Sales (account 4010) are $367,531.19 before HST; line 101 must agree. The difference between HST collected and remitted ($11,231.72) is other income (adjusting entry 04-AJE-01).

flags.rule: card batches are net of fees and include tips and HST
flags.detail: Each MONERIS TEST BATCH deposit is gross sales plus HST plus tips less about 2.6% fees. Gross it up: sales to 4010, HST to 2050, tips to 2070, fees to 6076 (monthly totals of fees are in onboarding). Weekly cash deposits are tax-included sales.
